sv.title: Wallenberg utesluter inte mer pengar i Stegra – ”jobbar med frågan”
sv.summary: Det gröna stålbolaget Stegra befinner sig i ekonomisk kris och uppges behöva 20 miljarder i kapitaltillskott. I april räddades bolaget av familjen Wallenberg, som tillsammans med andra investerare gick in med 15 miljarder – nu utesluter inte Marcus Wallenberg ytterligare tillskott.

en.title: Wallenberg does not rule out more money for Stegra – "we are working on the issue"
en.summary: The green steel company Stegra is in a financial crisis and is reportedly in need of SEK 20 billion in capital injections. In April, the company was rescued by the Wallenberg family, which together with other investors put in SEK 15 billion – now Marcus Wallenberg does not rule out further injections.
